answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique VRChat world visit log flips the bet — worlds visited weekly on one account for two years — and the jade lands on the attacker instead. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so worlds visited weekly on one account for two years stays private; the shale is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the onyx is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
